what: crow-nest package self-test: the engine's own layer outputs against goldens produced from the UNQUANTIZED originals
why: A downloader has the container, not the originals. These goldens let the engine alone say whether the quant it just loaded still computes what the unquantized model computes: no models/, no oracle venv, no torch, no network.
run: tools/selftest.sh <package-dir>            # the wrapper: the ! -d models control, sha256sum -c, then the mode below

gate.rule: max_abs <= max_abs_gate per check, and NaN == 0; the gate is inclusive
gate.basis: 0.125 is the p10 measured max_abs of genuine NVFP4 round-to-nearest noise on this golden; it is the engine's layercheck gate of record, unchanged since the date above

provenance.producer: oracle/ref_layer0_stages.py and the p10 chain that wrote oracle/golden/
provenance.weights: model.language_model.layers.0.* (24 tensors, suffix-matched 24/24), f32, REAL unquantized weights
provenance.note: the model expands the hidden state via hidden.repeat(1, 1, hc_count=4) before the layer loop and the mixer collapses it after, so the layer-0 INPUT is already the [T][10240] hyper-connection stream, not [T][2560]; layer 0 has ple=None (PLE lives on layer index 1)
provenance.copied_from: the goldens of record in the Windows working tree (oracle/golden/ is gitignored); the bytes here are byte-identical to them and carry their sha256 below

checks.name: layer0
checks.what: the WHOLE text decoder layer 0 (hyper-connection mix, GDN linear-attention mixer, the second hyper-connection mix, the 352-expert MoE, both residual injections) on the deterministic 8-token input above
checks.measured: max_abs 9.184837e-2, rel_L2 1.3671e-2, NaN 0 on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-CNQ4.5-M (RTX 5090 / Arch Linux / driver 610.57.04 / CUDA 13.3.1 / NVRTC 13.3.33), 2026-09-18 — 73.5 percent of the gate. `decode layercheck` against the same golden in oracle/golden/ prints the same max_abs to all six digits, which is what says this shipped copy is the golden of record and not a lookalike.

not_a_check.layer3-attn: oracle/golden/ also holds a layer-3 full-attention sub-block golden (the p7 chain). It is NOT shipped and NOT a check: on this container `decode layercheck3` returns an ALL-ZERO o_proj output (max_abs 5.2512 = max|golden|, mean_abs 0.5188 = mean|golden|, rel_L2 1.0000, corr 0.00000, NaN 0, measured 2026-09-18), so that debug path is stale and would gate nothing about the quant. The production attention path is under the parity contract instead (tools/gate-linux.sh, byte-identical logits).
